scope: User-authorized continued existing-V7 development with internal EA/MQH/ML inputs, one serial Optimization stream

comparison.1_entry_signal: The fixed scalar entry-risk ONNX/online bundle has no survivor. Do not reopen it with another threshold, feature or model.
comparison.2_external_market_event: External economic indexes, announcements and event datasets are excluded by latest user direction; no source acquisition or substitute.
comparison.3_order_time_session: Preserve existing V7 broker-native timing and opportunity identity; no new timing evidence currently justifies a separate change.
comparison.4_position_management_exit: Selected new question: learn conditional continuation from in-position completed native price observations, with an attributable optional early close. This changes exit decisions, not the rejected entry-score allocation. Original entries, sizing and protections can remain exact for attribution.
comparison.5_portfolio_capital_risk: Existing compounding is retained while exit alpha is evaluated. The rejected entry-risk score supplies no allocation or steeper-lot seed.
comparison.7_diagnostics_causal_meta: Bounded source schema and native M1 provenance inventory support implementation. No independent diagnostic study, checker or adjacent audit stream opens.

prospective_boundary: No root, price feature, candidate output or new native runtime exists yet. Freeze checkpoint/horizon/features/model/update/roles/periods/costs and rejection rules before new outcomes.
causal_design_constraint: Online fixed-horizon price labels must mature after their feature timestamp and remain observable after early close; do not call an early-close cash outcome a counterfactual HOLD label.
